model_annotations.Bulgarian: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-2, comparing three conditions: sparsity before the gate, after the gate, and after an average gate. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to 22 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0 with a linear scale and tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The blue dashed line with no markers represents the sparsity ratio before the gate, starting at approximately 0.18 at layer 0, decreasing to around 0.03 by layer 5, and remaining near 0.01 for the rest of the layers, with an average of 0.03. The orange dotted line with no markers represents the sparsity ratio after the gate, starting at 1.0 at layer 0, decreasing to around 0.45 by layer 5, then fluctuating between approximately 0.2 and 0.4 for the remaining layers, with an average of 0.44. The green dash-dotted line with no markers represents the sparsity ratio after the average gate, starting at 1.0 at layer 0, decreasing to around 0.35 by layer 5, then gradually declining to approximately 0.05 by layer 22, with an average of 0.33.
model_annotations.Chinese: The plot illustrates the sparsity ratio of SDPA (Scaled Dot-Product Attention) output across different layers, with a threshold of 1e-2, comparing three conditions: sparsity before the gate, after the gate, and after an average gate. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," ranges from 0 to approximately 22, with tick marks at intervals of 5, and uses a linear scale. The y-axis, labeled "Sparsity Ratio," ranges from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2, also on a linear scale. The blue dashed line (sparsity ratio before gate, avg 0.03) starts at approximately 0.18 at layer 0, drops sharply to around 0.05 by layer 2, and remains near 0.02 for the rest of the layers, ending near 0.01 at layer 22. The orange dotted line (sparsity ratio after gate, avg 0.44) begins at 1.0 at layer 0, decreases to about 0.45 by layer 5, continues to decline to roughly 0.2 by layer 10, and then fluctuates between 0.15 and 0.40 for the remaining layers, ending near 0.35 at layer 22. The green dash-dotted line (sparsity ratio after average gate, avg 0.33) starts at 1.0 at layer 0, drops to about 0.8 by layer 2, continues decreasing to approximately 0.35 by layer 10, and then gradually declines with minor fluctuations to around 0.05 at layer 22.
